title: Shortness of Breath
correct_orders: Doppler, lower extremities, venous / Duplex ultrasound
Heparin, low molecular weight OR Fondaparinux OR Rivaroxaban OR Apixaban OR Dabigatran OR Edoxaban
should_avoid: Starting a broad-spectrum antibiotic therapy without culture results
Thrombolytics without confirmed massive PE and hemodynamic instability

rationale.Chest X-ray: Obtain to evaluate for alternative causes of dyspnea and assess cardiac silhouette. May show Westermark sign or Hampton hump in PE but is often normal.
rationale.EKG: Assess for right heart strain pattern (S1Q3T3, right axis deviation) and rule out ACS.
rationale.Troponin: Elevated troponin in PE indicates right ventricular strain and worse prognosis.
rationale.Arterial blood gases: Evaluate for hypoxia and calculate A-a gradient. PE causes increased dead space.
rationale.Doppler, lower extremities, venous / Dup: Confirm DVT as embolic source. Positive + high pretest probability establishes diagnosis.
rationale.CT pulmonary angiography (CTPA): Gold standard diagnostic test for PE. Visualizes filling defects in pulmonary arteries. Obtain after initial stabilization and risk stratification. Definitively confirms diagnosis.
rationale.Heparin, low molecular weight: Immediate anticoagulation is the cornerstone of PE management.
rationale.Oxygen: Patient presents with shortness of breath and hypoxemia. Immediate oxygen crucial to stabilize.
rationale.CBC with differential: Assess for anemia; baseline prior to anticoagulation.

hpi: Ms. X is a 50-year-old woman with no significant past medical history who presents to the emergency department with acute onset shortness of breath. The dyspnea is severe, associated with chest discomfort and tachycardia. On arrival she is tachypneic with an SpO₂ of 94% on room air.
physical_exam: RR 27, tachypneic; SpO₂ 94% on room air; clear to auscultation bilaterally

patient_voice.chief_complaint: I can't catch my breath — it came on so fast out of nowhere. I'm really scared.
patient_voice.history: I was just at home sitting down and suddenly I felt like I couldn't breathe. No coughing, no fever.
patient_voice.pain: There's this tightness in my chest. I'm afraid something bad is happening.
